## Checklist

Commits must follow Conventional Commits; they are validated locally by
commitlint via the husky commit-msg hook. With squash-merge, the PR title
becomes the commit subject, so it must be conventional too:

  feat: ...      fix: ...      feat!: ... (breaking)
  perf:, refactor:, chore:, docs:, ci:, test:, style:, build:, revert:
-->
